text:
Abe Hamadeh addresses political controversies and legislative priorities in recent tweets
L. A. Wagner
Congressman Abe Hamadeh, who represents his district after winning the 2024 general election against Gregory Whitten with 56.5% of the vote, has made several statements on social media addressing current political debates and legislative priorities.
On July 15, 2026, Hamadeh’s office commented on recent criticism surrounding Todd Blanche’s prior legal work for former President Trump. The post stated: "JFK appointed his own brother as Attorney General. Eric Holder openly called himself Obama’s wingman. You can spare us the phony outrage that Todd Blanche’s prior work for President Trump somehow disqualifies him."
Later that day, Hamadeh announced support for legislation to end America’s twice-yearly clock changes. In a tweet posted at 20:00 UTC, he wrote: "NEW Congressman Hamadeh Supports Permanent Solution to America’s Twice-Yearly Clock Changes Read Press Release https://t.co/Ls59xNLXVB https://t.co/PQXgUW83Jk".
At 22:00 UTC on July 15, Hamadeh referenced Speaker Johnson in a post warning about perceived threats from political opponents. He wrote, ".@SpeakerJohnson isn’t one for hyperbole. We should all take him seriously: the barbarians are inside the gates. The radical left is playing for keeps. Republicans must deliver on our promises to the American people, or watch these Marxists seize power and destroy our country."
Hamadeh assumed office following his victory over Gregory Whitten in the 2024 general election by a margin of 56.5% to 43.5%.
